htmlTitle: Flieber | The Decision Making Tool For Modern Commerce

params.add_content:
Easily
integrate Flieber

with everything you use

Using a mix of native and assisted integrations, Flieber connects to any system, allowing you to pull the exact data you need to make smarter decisions faster.

• SalesAny successful inventory planning process starts with an accurate sales forecast. Flieber integrates with all your sales channels (website, marketplaces, wholesale etc.) to generate highly accurate AI-based forecasts that will serve as the foundation to your planning process.
  • InventoryYour current inventory position is critical information to understand how many days of stock each product has left. Even if you use a small 3PL with no APIs, you can still automatically feed all your inventory balances into Flieber to get an accurate picture of where each product stands.
  • ShipmentsKnowing the units that are in production or in transit and when they will arrive in stock is critical for making the right sales decisions. Flieber not only integrates with your spreadsheets or systems, but also allows you to manage purchase and transfer orders in-app. 

Flieber makes it easy to integrate with these crucial systems. You’ll be pulling the real-time data you need for forecasting sales and inventory across all channels and inventory locations, planning cost-effective replenishment, and keeping the right amount of stock on hand.

Flieber works with your tools (even the less common ones)

Modern commerce demands endless tools and connecting with all of them is impossible. Well… Not with Flieber! With a mix of innovative data modeling and AI-based mapping, Flieber is able to connect with ANY system through both our native and assisted integrations. No more need to manually update information across multiple systems.

params.heading_content:
Native Integrations

Flieber offers native one-click integrations with your main sales platforms and marketplaces.

integration_columns.add_content: Easily connect one or multiple Amazon stores from any marketplace into one Flieber account to receive recommendations for both purchases from suppliers and transfers to FBA.

Easily connect one or multiple Shopify stores into one Flieber account and set your specific use cases, including kits/bundles, backorders, and wholesale channels, to receive purchase recommendations for all your products in all your inventory locations.
Easily connect one or multiple Walmart stores into one Flieber account to receive recommendations for both purchases from suppliers and transfers to WMS.
Easily connect one or multiple eBay stores into one Flieber account to receive purchase recommendations for all your products in all your inventory locations.
Easily connect one or multiple Etsy stores into one Flieber account to receive purchase recommendations for all your products in all your inventory locations.
Easily connect one or multiple BigCommerce stores into one Flieber account to receive purchase recommendations for all your products in all your inventory locations.

If you want to keep using your spreadsheets, no problem—any sales, inventory or shipment data can be directly connected and synced with Flieber. We can even help you automate the data flow so that you don’t have to worry about manual changes.

params.heading_content:
Assisted Integrations

Flieber uses a combination of advanced data modeling and AI-based mapping to connect to any system, even the ones not natively integrated with our platform.
